mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `groups` ( group_id, moim_account_id, user_id, invite_code, group_name, group_count, custom_rule, challenge_type, content, future_deposit_ratio_rule, duration_days, min_count, round_cycle_days, base_deposit_amount, group_status ) VALUES ( #{groupId}, #{moimAccountId}, #{userId}, #{inviteCode}, #{groupName}, #{groupCount}, #{customRule}, #{challengeType}, #{content}, #{futureDepositRatioRule}, #{durationDays}, #{minCount}, #{roundCycleDays}, #{baseDepositAmount}, #{groupStatus} )
mapper.select: SELECT g.group_id, g.group_name, g.group_count, g.group_status FROM `groups` g LEFT JOIN group_users gu ON g.group_id = gu.group_id WHERE g.user_id = #{userId} OR ( gu.user_id = #{userId} AND gu.group_user_status = 'ACTIVE' ) GROUP BY g.group_id, g.group_name, g.group_count, g.group_status ORDER BY g.created_at DESC
